deserialize_model_from_package: deserialize a PyTorch model from a serialized package dict with optional strict mode
serialize_model_to_package: serialize a PyTorch model with captured init args and state dict into a package dict
swap_model_state_temporarily: temporarily swap a model's state dict within a context manager and restore on exit
